## Services — The Second Mortgages | Private Lending With Bob Berri
URL: https://thesecond.squarespace.com/services
Type: page
brand: The Second Mortgages | Private Lending With Bob Berri

We offer straightforward access to second mortgage financing with competitive rates and minimal friction. No appraisal means fewer delays and less out-of-pocket cost upfront. It’s a faster, simpler way to unlock your home’s equity when you need it most. Our process is built for speed, clarity, and real-life flexibility.

## Bridge Financing Explained for Home Sellers — The Second Mortgages | Private Lending With Bob Berri
URL: https://thesecond.squarespace.com/bridge-financing-explained-for-home-sellers
Type: page
brand: The Second Mortgages | Private Lending With Bob Berri

Timing mismatches between buying and selling properties create one of the most stressful financial gaps homeowners faces. In competitive markets, buyers often secure a new property before the sale of their existing one closes. When those closing dates do not align, bridge financing becomes a practical short-term funding solution.
